newsitem.title: USA: John Hancock to sell Freedom Securities unit.
newsitem.headline: John Hancock to sell Freedom Securities unit.

text.p: John Hancock Financial Services said late Friday that it has an agreement with the management of its Freedom Securities subsidiary for the unit's management to buy the unit from John Hancock for $180 million in cash and an ongoing interest in the company.
John Hancock said the outside equity partners for the transaction are Thomas H. Lee Co and SCP Private Equity Partners LP.
The company said it expects the transaction to close in the fourth quarter.
